10. CONCLUSION
This plan, including applicable drawings and tables, sets forth an erosion and sediment pollution control plan for construction of the Bad Creek Pumped Storage Project. The various measures included in, but not limited to, this plan will be implemented to protect surface waters from sediment pollution.
